headline: Approved $375,497.83 Apple device lease, a monthly spending report, and an out-of-state award conference trip.
summary: The Apple lease runs longer than three years, so city council approval is also being sought. The meeting also approved a monthly spending report and a trip to a national award conference, and honored a student who performed CPR.
decisions: Approved the Permission to Enter items, including a $375,497.83 Apple device lease, 5 yes and 2 absent.
Approved requiring a monthly finance update on year-to-date spending for all general fund line items, 5 yes and 2 absent.
Approved the home education plan with one student removed, 5 yes and 2 absent.
Approved accepting and spending allocated FY 27 awards, 5 yes and 2 absent.
Approved accepting donations from the Justin J. Watt Foundation, 5 yes and 2 absent.
Approved conference and convention requests 10.1 to 10.4 as a bundle, 5 yes and 2 absent.
Approved the out-of-state conference request for February 2027, 5 yes and 2 absent.
discussion: Apple device lease: Members questioned why the lease was listed before the full committee voted on it. Staff said Apple raised the price by $50 per device and asked for a decision.
Lease interest rate: Members said no report came back on a requested lower rate. Staff said Apple would not change the lease price.
Monthly budget update: Members supported a monthly report of year-to-date spending, saying it would help with budgeting in difficult times.
Out-of-state award conference: Members said the national award was worth celebrating and that staff should attend to receive it.
